policy.priority: Reviewed locked term_registry entries override observed memory.
policy.use: Reuse an observed target for an exact source entity when no locked rule conflicts. Conflicted observations are excluded from prompt memory.
policy.promotion: Observed mappings are consistency memory, not reviewed canonical terminology. Promote reviewed concepts to term_registry.json.
